records.name: Norta web Schulden-Mapper
records.scope: Public web calculator only; installed mobile app not tested
records.adoption_popularity_evidence: Not established; identified for direct workflow overlap, not qualified as a top app
records.effectiveness_evidence: No independent outcome evidence verified; marketing statements not accepted as proof
records.task: Reject optional cookies; select Inkasso; enter fictional creditor and balance 1200; inspect total and save disclosure
observed: German interface with English switch and multiple debt categories
Single entry exposes creditor-name and remaining-balance fields
Synthetic 1200 input rendered as 1.200,00 EUR and one claim
Save FAQ explicitly states no device persistence, transmission or transfer to mobile app; users re-enter values manually
Mobile app is stated to provide plans/reminders; those flows were not inspected
Visual inspection at current browser viewport showed warm neutral background, serif headings and sans-serif body text; only a partial scrolled view was examined
records.hypothesis_implication: Persistence and a user-reviewed preparation handoff may distinguish a research prototype from this specific web mapper, but mobile-app overlap and user value remain unproven
records.interaction_note: Exact Playwright name lookup failed for the FAQ; fresh accessibility state and exposed button index successfully opened it. No feature absence inferred from locator failure.

records.name: Actual Budget public demo
records.scope: Public synthetic demo in desktop IAB; no bank or server connected
records.task: Try demo; dismiss tour; Schedules; add Synthetic annual insurance for 120.00, annual repeat; Apply; Add; reload
observed: Schedule editor exposes amount approximation, account/payee, start date, repeat interval and upcoming dates
Saved synthetic schedule visible in table and persisted after reload
Date calendar initially intercepted frequency click; Escape dismissed it and frequency then worked; not misreported as missing feature
Dense dark-blue sidebar/table layout at default viewport; rightmost columns outside current screenshot
